claims: The Artemis II crew successfully splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California, on April 10, 2026, at 8:07 p.m. ET.
The Orion capsule landed approximately 40 to 50 miles from the San Diego coast.
Artemis II was a 10-day mission around the moon.
The Artemis II astronauts were retrieved by the USS John P. Murtha.
The splashdown date was Friday, April 10, 2026.
The splashdown time was 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
The spacecraft was the Orion capsule "Integrity".
The recovery vessel was the USS John P. Murtha.
The Artemis II mission marked the first time humans returned to Earth from lunar orbit since 1972.
